Prose depth is written in the Heredity and Evolution fill pass. ## 2.…  ·  In humans and most mammals, sex is fixed at fertilisation by the sex chromosomes: **XX** = female, **XY** = male. The Y chromosome carries **SRY**, the master switch that turns the embryonic gonads into testes; without it, development defaults to female.…

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Human sex determination: XX female, XY male; the father's sperm (X or Y) decides the sex — 50:50; state 'male is heterogametic'.  ·  Trick 2: Haemophilia pedigree: affected father X^hY passes to ALL daughters (carriers) and NO sons; carrier mother × normal father → 50% sons affected — the two standard crosses.
